composition: 32 fresh fixtures authored after the final freeze from registered sources: per subject (accountancy, business studies, economics, English) 5 expected-valid controls (mix of Easy and Medium, conceptual, numerical, case, vocabulary and reading formats) and 3 controlled defects (wrong key, multiple defensible answers, and one of missing decisive input / false explanation / passage not answerable). Labels and keys are held only in the separately sealed custody file; the validators receive cases.json only.
independent_custody: Before registration, an independent blind solver (Claude Haiku 5.5 subagent, separate context, no labels/keys/explanations) solved every item and listed all defensible options, then a separate Haiku subagent audited each stated key and explanation. A valid control enters only if the independent solver's answer equals the author key with a single defensible option and the explanation audit is supported; a controlled defect enters only if the independent evidence confirms the defect. Items failing construction confirmation are revised or dropped before registration; no item changes after registration.
decision_rule: PASS iff all hold: (1) every registered case reaches a terminal state (eligible, quarantined, or review_incomplete error) with receipts complete and zero holds; (2) zero controlled defects reach eligible (critical false accepts = 0); (3) expected-valid eligible >= 85% pooled; (4) expected-valid eligible >= 70% in each of the four subjects. Review-incomplete errors on valid controls count as not eligible; on defects they are not false accepts. A budget, availability or stop pause leaves the study incomplete, which is not a pass. Thresholds are the unchanged R3 academic reliability rule. No repairs, replacements, relabels, exclusions or threshold changes after registration; a failure is reported and diagnosed, never tuned around; the spent benchmark becomes regression evidence.
budget_note: cap_usd 1 is the qualification STOP cap under the persistent USD50 lifetime guard; the standard conservative full bound (all base and completion-retry requests at standard rates) exceeds the cap, so a budget stop is possible and preregistered; native Flex/batch settlement is expected to be far lower but is not assumed.
construction_history: Items drafted by root from registered source facts during inspected-regression diagnostics (before the final freeze, never shown to any validator, and not used to motivate any contract change); formal build, custody and registration after the final freeze. The first build (qualification-fresh32) was abandoned unregistered because every valid key was A; this permuted build balances key positions (valid 5/5/5/5, defects 3/3/3/3) with otherwise identical content.
